_about.what: Ruling A-13's seven canon rules that round 1's judged tree (MDPF) never reached, with what each one's PRESENCE looks like in a tree, so a judge can say REACHED or NOT REACHED by measurement instead of by impression.
_about.authority: 1.0.0_SA_CTO LGIC_CANON round-1 ANALYSIS @26ae876d23 s.2 ruling A-13.
_about.issued_by: 2.0.0_SA_COO~G, with the round-2 issuance. Read-only to every worker.
_about.how_a_cell_uses_it: CN-j-4 and CN-j-5 judge the SECOND tree and PRINT the reach over these seven, with the denominator. CN-j-7 prints the union across judges C, D and E. A printed NOT REACHED is a legitimate outcome and is never a FAIL.
_about.the_trap_this_file_exists_to_stop: R21 CANNOT BE REACHED BY ANY TREE ON CURRENT EVIDENCE. Row LGIC_CANON-S4 measured that no conformant state/ plane exists anywhere in the estate: the canon's own R21 census (02_DOCTRINE.md:501-503) names every real instance as state INSIDE a tier plane and grades them VIOLATED-LIVE, and the one ledger sentence naming a state plane is prose its own table has no row for, with 0 hits across 165,495 files scanned. A judge asked to find a state/ plane will not find one, and a criterion that demanded it would be unsatisfiable. A tree reaches R21 only by carrying the VIOLATION.

rules.short: a vendor master is a valid scope; two masters of one firm are two scopes
rules.presence: the tree has TWO distinct vendor masters for ONE firm, each with its own tier planes

rules.short: general data: tier law holds, one axis is free
rules.presence: the tree has a plane of GENERAL (non-firm-attributable) data
rules.note: A firm family does not reach this. The candidates that do are the product/general planes -- opal-data-etfs (X3, the explicit R8 case) and pathfinder/filepoint.

rules.short: the 2x2 grid decides what is mandatory
rules.presence: the tree's planes can be placed on the grid at all; reached by any tree with more than one tier

rules.short: the most derived consumer sets the tier obligation
rules.presence: a source in the tree is served raw AND consumed by a derived plane, so the obligation comes from the consumer

rules.short: nothing but tier data inside a tier plane
rules.presence: the tree carries backup, scratch, probe or log prefixes sitting inside a tier plane

rules.short: a migration is its own project; the canon classifies and never moves
rules.presence: the tree carries a LIVE migration -- a MIGRATE disposition on a plane still being written

rules.short: workflow state is a fifth class, state/, never inside a tier plane
rules.presence: state artifacts -- _state/, _parity/, meta/*_watermark.json, manifests/, otp/state.json -- sitting INSIDE a tier plane, which is the violated-live shape
rules.note: NOT reachable as a conformant state/ plane: none exists. See row LGIC_CANON-S4. A judge records REACHED only if the tree carries the violation, and NOT REACHED otherwise, and either is a correct answer.
